name: Checkbox
purpose: Accessible checkbox control with optional visible label and description.

api.element: Use a native input[type=checkbox] inside a label element.
api.label: Include .checkbox__content with .checkbox__label and optional .checkbox__description; omit the content group when no visible text is required.
api.accessibleName: When visible label text is omitted, set aria-label on the input.

usage: Include ../check/check.css and checkbox.css. See example.html for label-present and label-omitted markup.
accessibility: The native checkbox supports keyboard interaction and form submission.
A visible label is associated by wrapping the input; use aria-label when it is omitted.
The browser focus indicator is retained on the visible checkbox box.
The decorative mark is hidden from assistive technology.
Use aria-labelledby for the visible label and aria-describedby for its description when both are present.
responsive: Desktop and Mobile component token values are identical; no breakpoint override is needed.
